crossRefs.note: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the…
You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;
for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God gives you.
You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you;
The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the…
He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite…

translations.web: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.
translations.bsb: When you enter the land that the LORD will give you as He promised, you are to keep this service.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass, when ye are come to the land which Jehovah will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
